title: MedImageInsight: AN OPEN-SOURCE EMBEDDING MODEL FOR GENERAL DOMAIN MEDICAL IMAGING

bias_targets.methodology: Stratifying model performance metrics (e.g., AUC for classification, absolute L1 error for regression) across male and female patient groups on medical imaging datasets such as LTCXR, RSNA BoneAge, and an independent private clinical X-ray dataset using KNN classification.

Organizing patients into specific age groups (0-20, 20-40, 40-60, 60-80, and 80-100 years) and evaluating classification performance metrics (AUC) across these cohorts on an independent private clinical X-ray dataset.
